chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, who said: Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ narrated to me, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Regarding a woman whose menstrual blood ceases at the end of her days, he said: If her husband is overcome by desire, then she should wash her private part, and then her husband may touch her, if he wishes, before she performs ghusl (ritual bath).

key_terms.يَمَسَّهَا: have contact with her; here referring to sexual relations

ai.seo_question: Can a husband have intercourse with his wife after her menstrual bleeding stops but before she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman whose menstrual bleeding has ceased before she has performed ghusl (ritual bath). It indicates that if the husband has strong desire, intercourse is permitted after she washes her private part, even before ghusl.
